title: The ATM just gave you $5,000 too much

segments.text: You ask the ATM for one hundred dollars. It gives you fifty-one hundred.
Your bank balance only dropped by one hundred.
Five thousand dollars nobody knows about.
Except the camera above the ATM. And the bank's audit at the end of the day.
Machines get loaded wrong. Banks usually find it within days.
Then your phone buzzes. Your bank.

ui.text: Please call us about your ATM withdrawal.

segments.text: Do you return it before they call back, or wait and see?
